reasons: Deviation is correctly characterized: Section 9 contains only a Y2K date-handling warranty, with no professional/workmanlike, conformance-to-documentation, compliance-with-laws or malicious-code warranty and no repair/replace/refund remedy, so an insert is the right remedy.

The redline is additive only — existing Section 9 text in p0060 is left untouched and the new warranty and remedy sentences are appended at the end of the section, which is the smallest edit that reaches the preferred position (12 months software / 90 days services, professional and workmanlike, laws, no malicious code, re-performance/repair/replace/refund at Vendor's option).

Correctly declines to redline the Section 12 disclaimer because its 'EXCEPT AS EXPRESSLY SET FORTH IN THIS AGREEMENT' lead-in already carves out express warranties, so the disclaimer does not swallow the inserted warranty; no wasted edit.
Comment is accurate, in tone and first person plural, states what changed and why, cites the playbook position and offers the 90/30-day fallback with the same remedies.
Deterministic checks (operation applicability and warranty period ≥ 90 days) both pass and are consistent with the rendered text.
